programme.desc: S02 E06 — From Scary to Stunning The road trip comes to an end as Retta reveals the winner of the Scariest House in America!; the winning house receives a $150,000 home renovation from HGTV's Alison Victoria, transforming their once scary house into a once-in-a-lifetime dream home.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S03 E03 — Barn Burner A family's unusual taste leads Jon and Kristina to a woodland creature design in an overhaul of their 1800s home and odd things are found behind the walls; the team builds a brand-new barn that features hanging fabric for aerial yoga practice.
programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Colorful Victorian Jon Knight and Kristina Crestin deliver an emotional renovation to a choppy 1800s Victorian home; the team makes sense of the space for the family and their Great Danes; design inspiration comes from unusual places, including an antique car museum.
programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer

programme.desc: S02 E03 — East Coast Farmhouse, West Coast Vibes It's the newest renovation yet as Jon Knight tackles a 50-year-old Colonial reproduction; the home needs major help, so Jon and Kristina bring in a bright West Coast design, adding much needed natural light, a vaulted ceiling and a dream mudroom.
programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Nineties Are Back Two teams of beloved '90s TV icons scour America in search of homes that are stuck in the past; and once they choose their house, they'll go head-to-head in a renovation competition, and it all begins with taking on some totally '90s kitchens.
programme.title: Totally '90s House

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Old European-Inspired Bedroom Newlyweds transform their white bedroom into a romantic getaway.
programme.title: Design on a Dime

programme.desc: S276 E01 — Your House or Your Wife After living apart for six months, a woman's new career finally brings her husband to Pittsburgh in search for their new home. She wants a farmhouse near her job in the suburbs, but he wants a place with walkability in the city.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S277 E01 — Twins Reunite in Dallas Identical twins and their husbands have a complicated home search near Dallas. The twins are finally reuniting after 40 years apart, but opinions are divided on whether to buy adjoining properties or if they should all live under one roof.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S276 E08 — Seeking the Cat's Meow After seeing their daughter off to college, empty nesters are relocating for her new job to Greenville, North Carolina. They're ready to focus on their creative interests and their two cats, but they're at odds on style, price, and location.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S235 E12 — Too Cramped for Comfort in South Carolina A South Carolina woman realizes it was more than a small mistake to try to go tiny with RV living; she's looking to spread out with a home off wheels, but when the realities of the market hit her wallet, she'll need to roll with the compromises.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S240 E09 — Racing Around in Indy An Indiana native is committed to buying a charming place similar to his childhood home in Indianapolis; he wants a place that's downtown and big enough for a future family, but he'll have to decide between living for now or living for the future.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S239 E07 — From Boston to New Hampshire Boston newlyweds are packing up to start a family in New Hampshire; he wants to be secluded with a modern cabin in the woods, but she's looking for a house with lots of charm that's around neighbors.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Worth the Wild Jack McBrayer hits the road to see which home is worth the while; he begins his search at a Bavarian-themed lodge, explores a two-tower maze house filled with art and sculptures, then tours a home converted from a 19th-century church.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Guess Who's Coming to Tour Jack McBrayer's hunt for wild continues as he takes a peekaboo inside a Brooklyn brownstone for sale and gets an update on a previous season's Wild House; later, he travels to Reunion, Florida, to tour a themed home with special guest David Bromstad.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Choose Your Adventure Things take an unusual turn as Jack steps into the '80s and visits a home featured in a popular supernatural show. A homeowner in Denmark shows off his digs, Jack visits a resort with 20 themed dwellings: a spaceship, a castle and a wizard's lair!
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E13 — Large and In Charge Jack explores an aviation-inspired home built on a lot previously leveled by wildfire. After an update about a successful wild home sale, Jack goes south to visit an incredible replica of the White House.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Enchanted Forest Jack sets off on a wild wanderlust adventure touring forest hideaways, and first is a family's fairytale cottage. Then, he visits a husband's dream home for his wife and a property that's an ever-evolving, livable artwork.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Rock Out Jack's wild adventures continue as he tours a townhome that's a love letter to Asheville, N.C.; he visits a crisp multi-dome that can withstand a natural disaster and tours a desert home that's carved into a mountain's natural bedrock.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: Midwest Charm to Gulf Shores Paradise David Bromstad checks in with past winners to see how they've grown into their dream homes; there's a cozy Ohio family retreat, a Florida couple's jackpot oasis, and a Gulf Shores beachside paradise a decade later.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S19 E09 — $15 Million Unites the Family Fresh off a difficult divorce, an Ohio woman scores a $15 million lottery win that's about to change everything; now, able to retire early, David helps her relocate back to her childhood home, Vero Beach, Florida, so she can be closer to her kids.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S19 E14 — Cathy's Millions: Snowbirder in Chief A lucky lady often wins small amounts, but she finally hit it big with $3 million on a scratcher; David Bromstad arrives to help her and her husband upgrade their vacation home for a bougier place in Murrells Inlet, S.C.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S18 E10 — Big Bucks in Boca Raton David Bromstad is on the hunt yet again for a couple in Boca Raton, Fla.; this is the third dream home they've called on David to find and now, David's wondering if he's doing something very wrong or very right!
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S19 E06 — Seven Million Big Ones A couple's 3-year-old daughter chose their $7 million winning lottery ticket! Now, David gets to upgrade them from the Poconos to the family-friendly suburbs of Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S18 E08 — A Lottery Dream Desert Oasis Already purchasing his family's dream home after scoring big on a $250,000 scratcher, a man strikes lucky again with a $1 million win; now, he's calling on David to brave the heat and search for a bigger, dream desert oasis in Casa Grande, Arizona.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S19 E03 — Snow Place Like Home in Hub 2.0 A lucky couple's ready to add a second dream hub to their collection! David has already found them a Florida beach hub, and now they're calling on him once again to search for a snowy fairytale cabin in the Pocono Mountains of Pennsylvania.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S19 E15 — Sue's Central Florida Dream With an inheritance helping her find the perfect home in Central Florida, a retiree prefers to say she's graduated from working. Now, the experts of retirement living, aka David's parents, are on hand to guide her through the popular destination.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home
